meta.title: Kirill Ivanov — Senior Frontend Developer
meta.description: Kirill Ivanov — Senior Frontend Developer (React, TypeScript, Next.js). Fintech and data-heavy enterprise web. Bratislava, Slovakia.

about.heading: 10 years of building the web
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Frontend Developer with 10 years of experience. Right now I'm building the investor-facing platform and fund pages for a global asset manager — React and TypeScript on top of an enterprise CMS.

Most of my work sits where financial data meets UI: fund performance, returns and holdings rendered across hundreds of CMS-driven pages, where numbers have to be right and pages have to stay fast and accessible.

I'm equally comfortable in the modern React ecosystem and in legacy stacks (jQuery, Razor, Episerver/Optimizely CMS), which lets me ship features in real-world enterprise codebases rather than greenfield demos.
Open to senior frontend roles — remote within the EU or Bratislava-based. Particularly interested in fintech, data visualization, and product companies with a strong engineering culture.

technologies.heading: Tech stack
technologies.text: The tools I work with day to day, from React and TypeScript to Optimizely CMS, plus the legacy stacks I've learned to modernize.

experience.heading: Experience
certifications: Prompt Engineering: How to Talk to the AIs

jobs.intro: Embedded with enterprise clients to build and modernize their public-facing web platforms. Across all engagements I've worked deep in the Optimizely (formerly Episerver) CMS ecosystem, bridging modern frontend stacks with established .NET/Razor backends.

projects.name: VanEck
projects.note: current engagement. Global asset manager with ~$199B AUM
bullets: Develop and maintain interactive financial visualizations on Highcharts — performance history, growth-of-10K, calendar returns, sector weightings, holdings breakdowns — used across hundreds of fund pages.
Build React/TypeScript components on top of Optimizely CMS and ASP.NET Core MVC, integrating modern frontend patterns into the existing Razor-based stack.
Optimize mobile performance (Lighthouse audits, JS bundle splitting, render-path improvements) on globally-served pages.
Implement responsive layouts and shared UI primitives in SCSS + Bootstrap; refactor legacy jQuery where it intersects with new React features.

projects.name: MyEvergreenWholesale.com
bullets: Rebuilt the entire product catalog from the ground up on React + Optimizely, replacing the legacy implementation.
Designed and shipped catalog UI, filtering, search and product detail flows.

projects.name: ConvaTec.com
bullets: Contributed to a full website redesign built on Web Components + Optimizely, before the team's broader shift to React.
Implemented frontend components and integrated them into the CMS-driven content model.

jobs.intro: Led the frontend redesign of one of Russia's largest photo and electronics e-commerce platforms, migrating the customer-facing site from a legacy stack to a modern React/Next.js architecture.
bullets: Rebuilt the site end-to-end on Next.js with SSR for SEO-critical pages (catalog, product, search), replacing the previous server-rendered templates.
Designed and implemented the data layer on Apollo Client + GraphQL, collaborating with backend on schema design and query optimization.
Built a reusable component library covering catalog, filters, cart, checkout and account flows; enforced consistency via TypeScript and Storybook.
Optimized Core Web Vitals on key landing and product pages — improved LCP and CLS to pass thresholds, which directly impacted organic search performance.
Worked closely with designers and product to ship the redesign in iterative releases without freezing feature delivery.

jobs.intro: Freelance frontend engagement with an e-commerce site specializing in agricultural machinery and equipment.
bullets: Implemented and maintained frontend features on top of the Magento-based storefront — catalog, product pages, search and category filtering.
Built custom theme components and adjusted templates to match design requirements within Magento's frontend architecture.
Worked independently on scoped tasks, coordinating directly with the client on priorities and delivery.

jobs.intro: Frontend developer at a Magento-focused e-commerce agency. Delivered frontend work across 7–8 client projects over nearly 4 years, on both Magento 1 and Magento 2 codebases, including migration projects between the two.
bullets: Developed and maintained customer-facing storefronts for retail clients: catalog, product, cart, checkout and account flows.
Built custom Magento themes and frontend modules on both Magento 1 and 2, adapting to each platform's templating layer (PHTML, Knockout.js for M2).
Contributed to Magento 1 → Magento 2 migration projects, rebuilding theme layers and frontend components on the new platform.
Integrated storefronts with payment gateways, shipping providers, analytics and marketing tools per client requirements.
Switched contexts frequently across parallel client projects, picking up each codebase quickly and shipping features under agency timelines.
Collaborated with backend (PHP/Magento) developers, designers and project managers in a multi-project agency environment.
